testcase.name: integer ranges reject both format and bounds violations
a missing required argument fails by name
the greedy argument takes the rest of the line with spacing intact
enums coerce case-insensitively and reject unknown constants
an unterminated quote is an error, not a guess
a spec may not declare a greedy argument anywhere but last
backslash escapes the next character, inside and outside quotes
unexpected trailing input fails at the extra token
plain tokens split on runs of whitespace
float ranges reject infinities and out-of-range values
double quotes group a phrase and are removed from the token
optional arguments absent from the line stay absent from the result
every documented boolean spelling parses to the same two values
